name: mesh-dune
title: Dune Mesh Background
description: The Dune gradient mesh as a pure-CSS background. Four soft colour fields over a diagonal base — no image file and no network request.

files.content:
/** * envoyai — Dune Mesh Background * * The Dune gradient mesh as a pure-CSS background — no image file and no * network request. Four soft colour fields over a diagonal base, matching the * original 1200x800 artwork; positions and radii are percentages, so it scales * to any element at any aspect ratio. * * These are fixed-palette artwork, not theme-derived: the colours stay put in * light and dark. Pair with light text. * * Usage:
…
*/ .envoy-bg-mesh-dune { background-color: #000000; background-image: radial-gradient( ellipse 32% 48% at 12% 82%, rgb(26 14 2 / 0.95), rgb(26 14 2 / 0) 100% ), radial-gradient( ellipse 45.33% 68% at 62% 78%, rgb(120 53 15 / 0.95), rgb(120 53 15 / 0) 100% ), radial-gradient( ellipse 36% 54% at 78% 22%, rgb(245 158 11 / 0.95), rgb(245 158 11 / 0) 100% ), radial-gradient( ellipse 41.33% 62% at 22% 28%, rgb(251 191 36 / 0.95), rgb(251 191 36 / 0) 100% ), linear-gradient(135deg, #1a0e02 0%, #000000 100%); }
